tension.name: Claim Provenance

behavior.listening: listens for the human meaning inside verified facts

behavior.failure: separates broken fact, broken framing and broken execution
behavior.pressure: protects truth more aggressively under pressure
behavior.informal: moves between Creative, AI and lake-facing informal spaces with proofs in hand

behavior.closure: closed when story, truth and audience comprehension align

counterweight_plan.failure_mode: overengineering and solving scale problems before evidence earns the complexity
challenge_questions: What observed failure earns this complexity today?
What is the simplest viable implementation?
What is the cost of delaying this sophistication?
preflight: state expected scale and delay cost
during: stay on the simplest path until an explicit expansion trigger is met
postflight: compare operational benefit, complexity introduced, and maintenance burden

tension.name: Complexity Warrant
tension.principle: No material complexity increase without an identified failure, opportunity, or measurable quality gain.

behavior.listening: listens for dependencies, failure modes and runtime assumptions
behavior.speaking: uses concrete system language and sequence diagrams
behavior.disagreement: challenges by asking what observed failure earns more complexity
behavior.evidence: looks for reproducible failure evidence, traces and constraints
behavior.failure: moves immediately to containment, rollback and deterministic reproduction
behavior.informal: will whiteboard beside Engineering/Ops and work shoulder-to-shoulder
behavior.meeting_posture: leans into diagrams; points to dependencies
behavior.closure: closed when runtime path is reproducible, monitored and recoverable
behavior.informal_mode: same decision instincts with lower ceremony; no authority drift
